title: Options with designated initializers
hints: `with_defaults` only has to look at each field: a `NULL` separator and a zero header or precision mean "not given", so replace them with the default.

`snprintf(NULL, 0, ...)` measures without writing. Keep a running total of what the whole text needs, and write each piece at `out + total` only while it still fits; `%.*f` takes the precision from an argument.
